resources.string: Triggers that message this recipient must be changed first.
In Slack, add the Incoming Webhooks app to a channel and copy its URL. It starts with https://hooks.slack.com/services/
In Discord, open Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook, then Copy webhook URL.
How to get a webhook URL
Stored encrypted on this device. Anyone with this URL can post to the channel, so keep it private.
When a trigger fires you\'ll get a notification. Tap it and your messaging app opens with the text ready, so sending takes one tap. Google Play doesn\'t allow apps to send texts on their own.
Texts send automatically from your phone number. Standard carrier rates apply.
Allow SMS so triggers can text automatically.
This recipient\'s details couldn\'t be read on this device (for example after restoring a backup). Enter them again.
✅ Test from Round The Corner: this recipient is set up correctly.
Opened your messaging app. Tap Send to finish.
The URL must start with https://
